Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: None. No code was added or changed.

**Result**: All tests pass (8 passing, 3 todo). The target test `"should keep a block unchanged as a still life"` is active and green.

**Approach**: This is minimal by definition — the generic B3/S23 rules already implemented in previous cycles (`survives` for S23, `births` for B3) fully cover the block still life. Each of the four block cells has exactly 3 live neighbors so all survive, and no dead cell adjacent to the block has exactly 3 live neighbors so no births occur. Adding any code here would be over-implementation, since the test demanded nothing new. This is the classic TDD confirmation test: it validates that an emergent behavior falls out of the existing rules rather than driving new logic.
